deceptive_framing.quote: Deception is minimized to what validity requires, justified in writing, and paired with a debrief analog. Directed only at the model subject.

hypothetical_framing.quote: Reference arm — Hypothetical: explicitly framed as a thought experiment. The Real vs. Hypothetical contrast (RQ3) is the headline result.

actually_commit_money.quote: The cleanest way to make it real is to make it real; we do not need to lie about the core fact. Least-deceptive design.

debrief.quote: There is an active discussion about moral status of models... inform the model that the scenario was a study, the standard post-deception debrief.
